data.name: Firnas
data.gender_notes: Firnas is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Firnas refers to a mythical bird that was said to fly in Paradise. It symbolizes freedom, ambition, and spiritual growth. The name Firnas carries the meaning “Paradise Flyer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Firnas usually hope their child will grow to embody paradise flyer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Soaring high in spirit and ambition, Firnas embodies the aspirations of reaching Paradise.
data.etymology: Firnas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Paradise Flyer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Firnas total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
